title: The Amount an Event Bill Is Settled With
content:
The amount a Private Event & Banquet Services event bill is settled with is the amount the bill was raised for, as the invoice entry standing in the event ledger records it, rounded to two decimal places at the end only, the parts themselves being left unrounded.

## Where the amount is read

The invoice entry for that booking in the agreement's event ledger carries the amount the bill was raised for, and that amount is what the settlement is worked from.

## Worked figure on hypothetical records

| Quantity | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Amount the invoice entry records the bill as raised for | 9330.00 |
| Amount the bill is settled with, rounded at the end only | 9330.00 |

Where the amount billed carries a fraction of a cent — 9330.004, say — it is carried as it stands and the two decimal places are taken once, giving 9330.00.

## Point of judgement

The figure read is the one the invoice entry carries for that booking, not the value the event was estimated or contracted at, and not the sum of the lines a client reads off the bill for themselves.
